title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.8.8
subtitle: A sharper interface and verified Linux support.

highlights.title: Refined onboarding
highlights.description: Welcome, What's New, and the startup splash now share crisp identity assets, compact layouts, rounded controls, and black title bars.

highlights.title: Consistent Bake controls
highlights.description: Windows and Linux keep Cancel available while disabling the native close control during active work.

highlights.title: Verified Linux release path
highlights.description: The native Companion, Blender 5.1.2 package, installation flow, and a real Gaia 0.22 simulation have been validated on Linux.
